events.summary: Duy secures the door with a wooden wedge and warning tape, then tells Linh to step back into the light.

metadata.summary: Duy secures the door with a wooden wedge and warning tape, then tells Linh to step back into the light.

evidence.quote: Duy không mở cửa thêm. Anh chèn một miếng gỗ vào khe, buộc dây cảnh báo qua hai trụ lan can rồi bảo Linh lùi về phần sàn có ánh sáng.

consequences: Linh moves back to the illuminated part of the floor
The door is partially secured

events.summary: An ties the boat outside and asks if they should inform ba Sam, leading Duy to change his mind and send an inquiry.

metadata.summary: An ties the boat outside and asks if they should inform ba Sam, leading Duy to change his mind and send an inquiry.

evidence.quote: Ngoài sân, An buộc lại thuyền. Cậu gọi vào hỏi có cần báo bà Sâm không. Duy nói chưa, rồi đổi ý.

consequences: An is instructed to ask ba Sam about the white crank

events.summary: Linh takes a wide-angle photograph of the door, ruler, warning tape, and Duy's hand as instructed.

metadata.summary: Linh takes a wide-angle photograph of the door, ruler, warning tape, and Duy's hand as instructed.

evidence.quote: Linh lùi hai bước, lấy khung rộng. Trong ảnh có cửa, thước, dây cảnh báo và bàn tay Duy đặt trên đầu gối.

consequences: Photographic evidence of the scene is captured

events.summary: Duy receives a phone call and responds that he has not touched anything yet.

metadata.summary: Duy receives a phone call and responds that he has not touched anything yet.

evidence.quote:
Điện thoại Duy rung. Anh quay tai phải về phía máy, mắt vẫn nhìn khe cửa. Linh chỉ nghe câu trả lời cuối:

“Vâng. Cháu chưa chạm.

consequences: Duy learns information from ba Sam regarding the door

events.summary: Three short knocks and a fourth dragged sound echo from beneath the floor, accompanied by water level shifts on the monitor.

metadata.summary: Three short knocks and a fourth dragged sound echo from beneath the floor, accompanied by water level shifts on the monitor.

evidence.quote: Từ dưới sàn vang lên ba tiếng gõ ngắn.

consequences: Linh alerts Duy silently to the activity on the recording monitor

events.summary: Mai Linh arrived at the city by ferry.

metadata.summary: Mai Linh arrived at the city by ferry.

evidence.quote: Mai Linh nhận ra âm thanh ấy trước khi nhận ra thành phố.

consequences: Mai Linh stepped off the ferry and entered the city.

events.summary: An met Mai Linh at the dock, introduced himself, and carried her suitcase.

metadata.summary: An met Mai Linh at the dock, introduced himself, and carried her suitcase.

evidence.quote: Cậu đứng lên, tự giới thiệu là An, mười chín tuổi, rồi đón va li.

consequences: An guided Mai Linh toward the boat instead of walking.

events.summary: Mai Linh met Mr. Hòa at the audio archive storage room.

metadata.summary: Mai Linh met Mr. Hòa at the audio archive storage room.

evidence.quote: Người ra đón cô là ông thủ kho gầy, áo sơ mi cài lệch một nút.

locations: Phòng lưu trữ âm thanh đô thị
consequences: Mr. Hòa gave Mai Linh the contract and an uncataloged ceramic piece from station Four.

events.summary: Mai Linh signed the twelve-day work contract.

metadata.summary: Mai Linh signed the twelve-day work contract.

evidence.quote: Cô ký.

locations: Phòng lưu trữ âm thanh đô thị
consequences: Mai Linh officially accepted the assignment to check and preserve damaged audio fragments.

events.summary: Linh, Duy, and Ông Hòa listen to an audio recording where a male voice is heard saying 'Mở cửa Bốn' at the forty-first second, and Linh notes that the voice might belong to her father.

metadata.summary: Linh, Duy, and Ông Hòa listen to an audio recording where a male voice is heard saying 'Mở cửa Bốn' at the forty-first second, and Linh notes that the voice might belong to her father.

evidence.quote:
Ở giây thứ bốn mươi mốt có giọng đàn ông.

Không phải một câu đầy đủ. Trước đó, một đoạn âm bị vỡ thành tiếng sạn. Sau đó, ai đó ho. Nhưng ở giữa, bốn tiếng đứng rất gần nhau:

“Mở cửa Bốn.”

Linh buông tay khỏi bàn.

Duy nhìn cô, rồi nhìn đồng hồ. Anh không hỏi. Cô biết mình phải ghi tiếp: tiếng nói nam, khoảng cao độ, mức nhiễu, không kết luận danh tính. Những từ chuyên môn đứng sẵn trong đầu nhưng không đi ra được.

Giọng ấy thấp hơn giọng cha cô nhớ. Hoặc trong trí nhớ, cha chỉ nói với một đứa trẻ nên giọng luôn mềm hơn. Cô nhớ ông gọi mình tránh xa mép kênh, nhớ cách ông kéo dài âm cuối khi chưa thực sự giận. Bốn tiếng vừa nghe không có âm cuối nào để bấu vào.

“Có thể là cha tôi,” cô nói.

consequences: Linh considered the possibility that the voice belonged to her father.
Duy suggested noting that she found the voice similar to her father's and stated a reference sample is needed.

events.summary: Linh calls her mother to inform her that she has found a recording at station Four, interrupting her mother's work.

metadata.summary: Linh calls her mother to inform her that she has found a recording at station Four, interrupting her mother's work.

evidence.quote:
Cô gọi mẹ. Đầu dây bên kia có tiếng kéo cắt lưới.

“Con tìm thấy một bản ghi ở trạm Bốn.”

Tiếng kéo dừng lại.

consequences: Linh's mother stopped cutting nets to speak with her.

events.summary: Duy waits for Linh at the foot of North Hill.

metadata.summary: Duy waits for Linh at the foot of North Hill.

evidence.quote: Duy chờ Linh ở chân Đồi Bắc.

consequences: They start their conversation easily.

events.summary: Nguyen Vu receives Linh and Duy in a meeting room to discuss warehouse conditions and station maps.

metadata.summary: Nguyen Vu receives Linh and Duy in a meeting room to discuss warehouse conditions and station maps.

evidence.quote: Nguyễn Vũ tiếp họ trong phòng họp có cửa kính nhìn xuống thành phố.

consequences: The survey permit is signed under specific conditions.

events.summary: An meets Duy and Linh at the foot of the hill with a thermos of hot water and a message from Ba Sam.

metadata.summary: An meets Duy and Linh at the foot of the hill with a thermos of hot water and a message from Ba Sam.

evidence.quote: An đón họ dưới chân đồi.

consequences: They receive a warning message from Ba Sam.

events.summary: Duy and Linh inspect Station Four, where they detect sound from a supposedly blocked pipe and hear a tapping noise from below.

metadata.summary: Duy and Linh inspect Station Four, where they detect sound from a supposedly blocked pipe and hear a tapping noise from below.

evidence.quote: Trạm Bốn thấp, tường gạch thẫm màu như đã hút nước vào tận lõi.

consequences: They discover unexpected underground water flow and a tapping sound in the dark.

events.summary: Linh comes to Bà Sâm's porridge stall and they discuss the history of the bell and past events.

metadata.summary: Linh comes to Bà Sâm's porridge stall and they discuss the history of the bell and past events.

evidence.quote: Linh ngồi xuống ghế thấp, đầu gối gần chạm mặt bàn.

consequences: Linh learns about the relocation of the bell and Bà Sâm's past at station Four.

events.summary: An sits by the stove fixing his raincoat and talks with Linh and Bà Sâm about leaving the city and the old ferry.

metadata.summary: An sits by the stove fixing his raincoat and talks with Linh and Bà Sâm about leaving the city and the old ferry.

evidence.quote: An ngồi cạnh bếp, vá áo mưa bằng băng dính trong.

consequences: An reveals his desire to hear the ferry's horn before leaving.

events.summary: Linh asks for permission and turns on her audio recorder to interview Bà Sâm regarding the bell and station Four.

metadata.summary: Linh asks for permission and turns on her audio recorder to interview Bà Sâm regarding the bell and station Four.

evidence.quote: Linh xin phép bật máy. Bà Sâm đồng ý

consequences: Bà Sâm recounts her memories of the bell transfer and her time at station Four.

events.summary: Linh returns home and has a meal with her mother, where they briefly touch upon the subject of her father.

metadata.summary: Linh returns home and has a meal with her mother, where they briefly touch upon the subject of her father.

evidence.quote: Nhà mẹ ở cuối một ngõ có giàn bầu.

consequences: Linh spots a suspicious gray cloth package hidden under a chair.

events.summary: Linh calls Duy from the porch after dinner to discuss the bell records and plan a visit to station Four.

metadata.summary: Linh calls Duy from the porch after dinner to discuss the bell records and plan a visit to station Four.

evidence.quote: Sau bữa cơm, cô ra hiên gọi Duy.

consequences: Duy agrees to look for the minutes and invites Linh to go to the station with him the next morning.
